title: Quick Tip: GitHub Copilot Billing: Setting the Record Straight
summary: GitHub Copilot billing changes from request-based to usage-based pricing on June 1, 2026, affecting how sub-agent costs are calculated. Under the new model, each sub-agent's token consumption is billed individually rather than at the highest multiplier rate, making model selection for individual agents financially significant.
key_points: Starting June 1, 2026, most Copilot subscribers switch to usage-based billing with per-token pricing and a monthly AI credits allowance
Request-based billing only continues for Copilot Pro and Pro+ subscribers on existing annual plans
Code completions remain unlimited and unaffected by billing changes
Under usage-based billing, each sub-agent's tokens are billed individually, unlike request-based billing where the highest-multiplier model determines the entire session price
Claude API rates in Copilot are comparable to direct API usage but differ from Claude.ai Pro flat subscription pricing

quotes.text: The price of an agentic session is determined by the highest-multiplier model used anywhere in the agent chain.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies how request-based billing works as contrast to usage-based billing, showing why the June 1 change matters for complex workflows

quotes.text: On usage-based billing, the per-token rates for Claude models inside Copilot are close to Anthropic's standard API rates.
quotes.why_it_matters: Helps users make cost comparisons between using Copilot and direct API access
